title: Rockwell Automation ThinManager ThinServer Null Pointer Dereference Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Rockwell Automation ThinManager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the ThinServer component. The issue results from dereferencing a null pointer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system.
